note: The script asks for nine graphics: the hook text, three question texts, two name supers, the event tag, the Push-ups for Putts tag and the word stack, then the end card. The anthem and the Toast to the Fallen rows have no text. NSF has no logo file in the repo yet, so the end card types the name.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: What question are they answering? Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Hook text in the top third, already on screen at 0:00. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04.

mg.title: The question revealed

text.main: Can you describe the Navy SEAL Foundation in one word and why?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:04, top third, 3 s: Can you describe the Navy SEAL Foundation in one word and why?
mg.use: Top third from 00:04 for 3 seconds, with the interviewer's voice over the golf carts. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Name super Chris Brown
mg.cue: Name super at 00:07, lower left, 2 s: Christopher Brown / Capt. (Ret.), USN.
mg.use: Name super from 00:07 for 2 seconds. Type the second line Capt. (Ret.), USN under it. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Event tag
mg.cue: Event tag at 00:11, upper left, 3 s: Sanctuary Golf Classic.
mg.use: Upper left from 00:11 for 3 seconds, over the registration shots.

mg.title: Push-ups for Putts tag
mg.cue: Topic tag at 00:24, upper left, 2.5 s, on the push-up shot: Push-ups for Putts.
mg.use: Upper left from 00:24 for 2.5 seconds, only while the push-up shot is on screen.

mg.title: Second question

text.main: What kind of support do they provide?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:28, top third, 2.5 s: What kind of support do they provide?
mg.use: Top third from 00:28 for 2.5 seconds, with the interviewer's voice. Keep captions on.

mg.title: The support he names
mg.cue: Key words as they are said, top third, word stack: caring for the families, scholarship programs, summer camps, emergency assistance.
mg.use: Top third over Chris. Bring each phrase in on its word: about 00:31, 00:35, 00:37 and 00:39 on the timeline. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Golf tip question

text.main: What is your best golf tip?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:55, top third, 2.5 s: What is your best golf tip?
mg.use: Top third from 00:55 for 2.5 seconds, as Tiffany starts. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Name super Tiffany
mg.cue: Name super at 00:56, lower left, 2 s: Tiffany Bitz / Sister of Navy SEAL Danny Dietz.
mg.use: Name super from 00:56 for 2 seconds. Type the second line Sister of Navy SEAL Danny Dietz under it. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: the Navy SEAL Foundation name in white on NSF blue #003C69, then one line: navysealfoundation.org.
mg.src: No NSF logo file in the repo yet (endcards/ has no NSF entry), so the name is typed until the logo is added. Colours from the NSF client file (navysealfoundation.org, mined 7 Jul 2026).
mg.use: After Tiffany's last line at 01:06. Hold it to the last frame. No fade to black. The name stands in for the logo until the logo is in the repo.
